dedupe_keys.name: urban building energy context climate and ev scenario inputs

description: This repository publishes inputs for an urban building-energy simulation sensitivity study using City Energy Analyst 4.0.0-beta.4. A scenario matrix and settings workbook specify which urban-context treatment, weather file and electric-vehicle charging database to apply in each run. The tree lists four Ottawa weather variants and databases labelled base, EV25, EV50, EV75 and EV100. A modeller could reuse the scenario design to test how adjacent buildings, climate assumptions and charging demand change simulated building loads. The repository also lists a CEA installation artifact, which this review did not download. Its Input Databases README says the EV100 package represents 25% adoption, in conflict with the filename; users must inspect that database before interpreting the scenario. No workbook, weather file or ZIP payload was opened, and no run was reproduced. GitHub reports MIT for the repository, while rights to embedded software and source weather or database material need separate checks. The geographic example is Ottawa, not a global measured building stock. Related resources include the linked Canadian CEA base database and official CEA runtime. A further caveat is that the charging-database contents and weather units were not inspected, so scenario labels alone do not establish numerical input values.
licence: MIT in GitHub repository metadata; embedded City Energy Analyst software and third-party weather/database contents retain separately unverified terms.
